title: The scalar Riccati equation 9 − P² = 0
caption: With A = 0, B = 1, Q = 9 and R = 1 the Riccati equation is −P² + 9 = 0. The positive root P = 3 gives the gain K = 3 and the closed loop ẋ = −3x.
alt: The downward parabola 9 − P² crossing the horizontal axis at P = 3, marked.
description: For ẋ = u the Riccati equation reads −P² + Q = 0, that is 9 − P² = 0.
K = R⁻¹BP = 3, and the closed loop is ẋ = −3x.
